name: ModelVariant762_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant762_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (after the delay staggered sparks shrink in towards the slot while a flash sprite grows over it, a fan and a spray of shards burst from the drifting centre and fade, then dots fall, a pulsing ring of quads spreads and four rolled wings rise); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds 32 sparks and the 16-point fan and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 on the first wing frame, 0 while any colour is still fading and 2 once every colour has faded; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-779 and 876 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

name: gModelVariant762_aConfigs
evidence: matching model_variant/variant762_entry.c: ModelVariant762_HandleRequest indexes this Model762Config[] table with its request command and keeps the selected &gModelVariant762_aConfigs[command] pointer in its work block (work->config), which later updates read, so each record is one command's configuration.
notes: Former gModelVariant762_D1FCC (offset-only name). Role name only.

name: gModelVariant762_PartPosition
evidence: matching model_variant/variant762_entry.c: while elapsed <= config->release the entry copies the translation of GsGetLwUnit(Model_GetSlotDataEntry(active slot, config->part)) into this SVECTOR, then RotTrans and setVector use it as the effect anchor, so it holds the configured part's position.
